## Problem / motivation

What world-simulation gap or player experience does this address? Which layer does
it touch (Population, Economy, Military, Diplomacy, Ecology, World History, API)?

## Proposed idea

Describe the mechanic at a high level. Remember the project rules: ledger-first,
nothing from nowhere, and original implementation (ideas may be studied, code must
be written from scratch).

## How it stays compatible

How should this augment vanilla / other mods without cancelling content or breaking
saves? Which Harmony patches (if any) and how thin can they be?

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you'd pick this one.

## Additional context

Links, references (as research inspiration only), or mockups.
